capabilities: Render byte-field diagrams from fenced code blocks
Define fields with names and byte lengths
Set the starting offset of the diagram
Create unnamed padding fields that reserve space
Wrap fields longer than the row width
extras: Syntax is minimal: each line is 'name:length'; lines without the ':' delimiter are treated as comments.
problem: Obsidian cannot natively render byte-field layout tables for documenting packet or memory structures.
summary: Renders byte-field diagrams from code blocks, showing memory or network packet structure layouts with field offsets.
